title: ChatGPT Hit 100 Million Users in Just 2 Months
hook: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in only 2 months.
closing: That speed made a chatbot mainstream before its business model caught up.
question: Do you use ChatGPT weekly?

segments.say: ChatGPT reached 900 million active users. The audience grew ninefold from its earliest listed milestone.
ChatGPT reached the benchmark in 2 months. No other listed app spread that quickly.
ChatGPT has 850 million free users. Most of its enormous audience pays nothing directly.
